nodes.title: Prompt
widgets_values:
integrated_multimodal_description:
Preserve the supplied video's original content and visual style. Keep the same subjects, identities, proportions, objects, composition, colors, lighting, actions, camera movement, shot sequence, and timing. Refine only details supported by the source, maintaining consistent edges and textures across frames. Retain the original degree of stylization and existing text and graphics.

overall_soundscape:
Preserve the source soundtrack and its timing.

non_diegetic_music:
Preserve any music already present in the source.

nodes.title: Input Preparation
widgets_values:
Input geometry and duration are detected automatically from the uploaded video. Rotation, pixel aspect ratio, source_scale and minimal 16-pixel VAE alignment padding remain unchanged. No widescreen input canvas is imposed.

Set the exact OUTPUT width and height manually in Upscale Latent. Examples: 1280 x 736, 1920 x 1088, 2560 x 1440, or portrait dimensions such as 1440 x 2560. Use dimensions supported by the model, normally multiples of 32. The displayed numbers are editable starting values; no automatic-size connection overrides them.

Output-size edits do not change automatic input sizing or source duration.

nodes.title: Requirements
widgets_values:
Requires the bundled input/refinement helper version 0.1.12, compatible ComfyUI MiniMax H3 support, OpenH3-Regenerate2K, KJNodes and VideoHelperSuite. Use your normal ComfyUI launcher.

Only output width and height are manual. Input sizing and source duration remain automatic. max_frames = 0 disables the optional input limit. Larger output dimensions and longer clips require more memory.

nodes.title: Model and Node Downloads
widgets_values:
# Models and Custom Nodes
Paths below are relative to your ComfyUI folder. Weights are downloaded separately.

## models/diffusion_models/
- [Singularity V2 pruned INT8](https://huggingface.co/WarmBloodAban/Minimax-h3_Singularity/resolve/1259cf16cd0b655ba691a32fb46a409142762972/Minimax-h3_Singularity_ref2va_v2_pruned_int8.safetensors?download=true)

## models/text_encoders/
- [Qwen3-VL 32B MiniMax H3 NVFP4 AWQ](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/text_encoders/qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors?download=true)

## models/vae/
- [MiniMax H3 video VAE INT8 ConvRot](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/vae/minimax_h3_video_vae_int8_convrot.safetensors?download=true)

- [MiniMax H3 audio VAE FP32](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/vae/minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors?download=true)

## models/latent_upscale_models/
- [Native learned latent upscaler BF16](https://huggingface.co/Efficient-Large-Model/Open-H3-Regenerate-2K/resolve/5809c33730c18b6b1c827b40974855a4288641b3/latent_upsampler/minimax_h3_latent_upscaler_3d_conv_v1_bf16.safetensors?download=true)

## models/loras/
- [open_h3_regenerate_2k_lora.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Efficient-Large-Model/Open-H3-Regenerate-2K/resolve/5809c33730c18b6b1c827b40974855a4288641b3/lora/open_h3_regenerate_2k_lora.safetensors?download=true)
- [sharp_curve_branches.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Efficient-Large-Model/Open-H3-Regenerate-2K/resolve/5809c33730c18b6b1c827b40974855a4288641b3/lora/sharp_curve_branches.safetensors?download=true)

## Required custom nodes
- [OpenH3-Regenerate2K by Songssx](https://github.com/Songssx/ComfyUI-OpenH3-Regenerate2K)

- [KJNodes](https://github.com/kijai/ComfyUI-KJNodes)

- [VideoHelperSuite](https://github.com/Kosinkadink/ComfyUI-VideoHelperSuite)

[Current ComfyUI with native MiniMax H3 support](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI)

Install [OpenH3 VideoTools 0.1.12](https://github.com/TensorAlchemist/ComfyUI-OpenH3-VideoTools/releases/tag/v0.1.12) into `ComfyUI/custom_nodes`. Install its `requirements.txt` using ComfyUI's Python, then restart ComfyUI normally.

## Prompt
The Prompt node contains a general preservation prompt for photo, anime, CG and other source styles. You can run it as supplied. For stronger scene guidance, add a short, accurate description inside integrated_multimodal_description. This text encoder does not analyze the upload. Generative reconstruction can still change details, text or motion; review the result.

Set OUTPUT width and height directly in Upscale Latent. Both fields are editable and have no automatic-size connections. Input sizing and duration remain automatic and unchanged. source_scale adjusts working input size; max_frames = 0 disables the optional input-frame limit. Timing follows the model's 24 FPS cadence.

## Component sources and terms
[Official OpenH3 project](https://nvlabs.github.io/Sana/Open-H3-Regenerate-2K/)

[Singularity model card and terms](https://huggingface.co/WarmBloodAban/Minimax-h3_Singularity)

[MiniMax H3 community license](https://huggingface.co/MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-H3/blob/6818f6c32d12b210915e44ad56a4228c2608f160/LICENSE)

Each component retains its own license.
